 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Chandra Mauli Chaurasia, Advocate  For the Respondent/s : Mr.Viveka Nand Singh, AC to GP-18  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 3 02-02-2026 Heard the parties.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the following relief/s:
(i) for issuance of a writ in the nature of 'mandamus' commanding upon the respondents No. 2 and 3 by restraining them to make any payment of the rest due compensation amounts to the respondents No. 4 to 29 under the provisions the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 with respect to an area of 70 decimals of land of the petitioner of Kheshra No. 2335 of Khata No. 1754 situated in Mouza- Ghataro, P.S. and Anchal Lalganj in the district of Vaishali acquired by the state govt. under the Hajipur Sugauli Railway Line Project No. 9 of 2007-08 till the pendency of T.S. No. 139 of 2006 in the court of learned Sub-Judge IInd Vaishali at Patna High Court CWJC No.20082 of 2016(3) dt.02-02-2026 Hajipur filed on behalf of the petitioner against the respondents No. 4 to 29 with respect to the aforesaid land in question along with some other lands which is pending for hearing till date even then the respondent No.
3

is bent upon to make payment of the rest due compensation amounts to the respondents No. 4 to 29 in spite of the objection petition filed on behalf of the petitioner before the respondent No. 3 earlier on record;
Patna High Court CWJC No.20082 of 2016(3) dt.02-02-2026 2.
On 25.08.2025, notice was issued to respondent nos. 04 to 29 and the order was peremptory.
3. As the same was not complied, it stood rejected on 22.09.2025.

4. Perused the file, consigned.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Ravi/-
